ONE pre-existing skip, INHERITED not introduced: runner-common/tests/test_git_helpers.py::test_clone_raises_on_auth_failure. It joined the gate at 12.7 when scripts/run_tier.py folded runner-common/tests into T1 - until then that suite (181 tests) was selected by no tier, so its skip was invisible rather than absent. Baselined here honestly, with what it would take to remove it: the test wants GitAuthError from a private repo, and GitHub answers 404 for private and nonexistent alike so the CLIENT cannot tell them apart. An assertion that does not depend on the remote's discretion needs a local git server that returns a real 401 - the repo has one (the backend's git endpoints), so the fix is to point the clone at it and delete this entry. Scoped by its reason text, which no other suite uses.
